notes.title: Available now in the game store!
notes.content:
Our game > is now available on the Steam store.
I am very happy to inform you that our game > is now available on the Steam store. Players can add it to their wishlists and follow it~

Since the game is still in the early stages of development, only the general framework has been completed. The specific playable scenes are still under development, so it may take a long time before the game is released. At this stage, we plan to participate in the Steam New Product Festival in June this year and upload our first playable demo, and strive to release the game within this year! (It shouldn't happen~)
